summary: First-run comprehensive test of Aug Studios / Lithos site. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (GET /api/, POST /api/contact valid/invalid variations, GET /api/contact list containing new record, status endpoints). Frontend: hero, nav pill, cursor-mask spotlight reveal, smooth-scroll for all pill items, Start Digging CTA, About with 3 stats, Services with all 10 categories, Industries with all 4 packages, Footer, and Contact form (empty-submit error toast + valid-submit success card + success toast) all working. Zero console errors on page load.

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside submit_contact (line 89) but defined only at module bottom (line 117). It works at request time due to late binding, but it is a code-ordering smell. Move logger init above the routes.

action_items: (Optional) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the route handlers in /app/backend/server.py for cleanliness (current works but is order-fragile).

(Optional) Nav item 'Course' currently scrolls to About and 'Field Guides' scrolls to Services etc. Labels vs targets are intentional per spec, but consider making labels match sections if this ever confuses users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger defined after usage in exception handler. Works because binding is at call-time but should be reordered.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'). Consider FastAPI lifespan handler.

Hero.jsx: RevealLayer generates a full-canvas dataURL on every requestAnimationFrame frame — this is expensive (canvas.toDataURL + Data URL parsing per frame). Consider using CSS radial-gradient mask directly with a moving position instead of dataURL round-trip, to reduce CPU/GPU load. Not blocking; visuals are correct.

Contact.jsx has both HTML `required` and JS validation. That's fine, but the JS toast.error path is only reachable if `required` is bypassed (which the test does). In real usage, native HTML validation triggers first — acceptable UX.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test contact records prefixed with TEST_ created in db.contact_requests during test runs. Not cleaned up (no delete endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be run via `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. All endpoints under /api. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is used as base URL. Contact form (POST /api/contact) returns 422 on invalid email / missing required fields. No auth. No _id leakage. Frontend uses data-testid IDs from /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/site.js.
